description.value: Cresta calls itself "The AI operating system for customer experience," letting human and AI agents work together across the customer lifecycle.

Cresta describes itself as "The AI operating system for customer experience." Its platform combines AI agents and human staff to handle customer conversations, automate back-office work and analyze interactions.
A B2B enterprise AI platform for contact centers.

product_description.value: Four product areas: AI Agent, Deputy Agent, Agentic Assist and Conversation Intelligence, plus Knowledge Agent and Quality Management (automated QA across 100% of conversations).

AI Agent, Deputy Agent (long-running agent that automates work from intent to completion), Agentic Assist (real-time guidance for human agents), Conversation Intelligence, Knowledge Agent and Quality Management.
Cresta AI Agent, agent assist, conversation intelligence, quality management and AI coaching, organized as Cresta for Agents, Cresta for Managers and Cresta for Business.

business_model_description.value: B2B enterprise software vendor. Pricing is negotiated privately, with custom pricing and private offers handled through the sales team.
Enterprise software-and-services model, inferred from the enterprise focus and AI-native transformation services; pricing is not stated.
